question: Under what condition must a gift be given to one who has previously accomplished something and has been tested for one year?
premises: A gift is prescribed as something to be given.
The recipient is one who has been previously accomplished.
The recipient must have been tested for the duration of one year.
inference: Transmission is restricted to a previously accomplished recipient who has passed a year-long test.
uncertainties: The nature of the gift itself remains unspecified in this verse.
plain_english: It is to be given to one who has previously accomplished and has been tested for one year.
